description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useTheme' that manages the application's theme mode (dark or light). It applies/removes a 'dark' CSS class to the document root based on the 'darkMode' boolean and provides a method to toggle dark mode.

methods.name: useTheme({ darkMode, setDarkMode })
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages theme mode, applying the 'dark' CSS class to the document root based on the 'darkMode' parameter and providing a toggle function.

methods.name: toggleDarkMode
methods.description: Function that toggles the 'darkMode' state by calling 'setDarkMode' with the opposite boolean value.
